opening.argument: The video walks viewers through Instagram’s own support workflow. It directs them to Report a Problem, tells them to select the nature of the issue, then explains how to type the details and send them. The visible Report a Problem menu and Feedback screen match those instructions. This is a demonstration of how to submit an account issue or feedback through Instagram settings. The requests to subscribe and visit TechBoomers.com are audience engagement and website promotion; they are not presented as conditions for receiving Instagram support.

citations.quote: On the next screen, scroll down and tap Report a Problem
From the menu that appears, select the nature of your issue
On the next screen type in the details of your issue or question. When you're done, hit send.
